tool_signatures.name: activate_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Activate a draft or paused queue. This schedules future public posts. The user must have confirmed the caption variants (contentConfirmed on create_evergreen_queue or update_evergreen_queue); otherwise this answers EVERGREEN_CONTENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_posts
tool_signatures.description: Apply one action to up to 25 posts: reschedule (needs scheduledAt), or status (draft or scheduled). Per-post failures are reported individually. To remove posts, use delete_post on each draft.

tool_signatures.name: create_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Create a draft Evergreen queue from an eligible published post. Creation does not activate it or schedule anything; activate_evergreen_queue does that separately.

tool_signatures.name: create_post
tool_signatures.description: Create a post for this brand. Without scheduledAt the post is saved as a DRAFT and nothing is published; with scheduledAt it is scheduled and the worker publishes it at that time. Pass either a single channel or a targets array (one entry per channel). Upload media first with upload_media and pass the asset ids. Read channel rules with get_channel_rules before posting.

tool_signatures.name: create_posts
tool_signatures.description: Create up to 25 posts in one call, for example a week of scheduled content. Each item takes the same fields as create_post. Failures are per item: the response lists ok/error for each, and the successful ones are created even when others fail.

tool_signatures.name: delete_post
tool_signatures.description: Delete a draft, or cancel a scheduled, failed, or waiting-to-be-posted post before it reaches any platform. Published posts cannot be deleted or taken down from here: that stays with the user in Markaestro. Posts mid-publish cannot be deleted until the run settles.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Performance over a window for the connection

tool_signatures.name: get_brand_profile
tool_signatures.description: A brand

tool_signatures.name: get_channel_rules
tool_signatures.description: The per-channel media, caption, and delivery-mode rules the API enforces, plus the draft-then-publish model. Read before creating posts.

tool_signatures.name: get_evergreen_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get source metrics, queue-lifetime metrics, tracked clicks, attributed conversions, and recent run outcomes. Unavailable provider metrics are null, not zero.

tool_signatures.name: get_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Get one Intelligent Evergreen queue including its caption variants.

tool_signatures.name: get_job_run
tool_signatures.description: Check the status of a publish run returned by publish_post: queued, running, succeeded, or failed, with the message and details.

tool_signatures.name: get_media
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one media asset: type, dimensions, processing state, thumbnail, and how many posts reference it.

tool_signatures.name: get_post
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one post with its targets, status, media, schedule, publish results, and live URL when published.

tool_signatures.name: get_post_analytics_history
tool_signatures.description: How one post earned its numbers over time: the metric snapshots taken 1h, 6h, 24h, 72h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, and 90d after publish (a post published directly on the platform starts with a discovered snapshot), with the growth between stages, plus the current totals and whether polling is still active. Takes any id from get_analytics or list_post_analytics. Answers NOT_FOUND for posts outside this brand.

tool_signatures.name: get_tiktok_posting_options
tool_signatures.description: Read posting options only for the user

tool_signatures.name: list_destinations
tool_signatures.description: List the publishable destinations (Facebook Page, Instagram account, TikTok account, ...) of a brand, with their ids and delivery modes. Use a destinationId on create_post only when a channel has more than one destination.

tool_signatures.name: list_evergreen_queues
tool_signatures.description: List this brand

tool_signatures.name: list_evergreen_runs
tool_signatures.description: List the generated occurrences and evaluation outcomes for a queue.

tool_signatures.name: list_job_runs
tool_signatures.description: List recent publish runs, optionally filtered by status or by the post id (resourceId).

tool_signatures.name: list_media
tool_signatures.description: List uploaded media assets with their ids, type, dimensions, and how many posts reference them.

tool_signatures.name: list_post_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Every post in the window (the connection

tool_signatures.name: list_posts
tool_signatures.description: List posts, newest first. Filter by status: draft, scheduled, publishing, published, platform_action_required, failed, partial_failed. On an all-brands connection, pass productId to list one brand. Use cursor from a previous page to continue.

tool_signatures.name: list_products
tool_signatures.description: List the brands (products) this connection can act on, with their connected channels: one brand for a single-brand connection, every brand in the workspace for an all-brands one. Call this first to learn each productId and which channels can be posted to.

tool_signatures.name: mark_post_posted
tool_signatures.description: Record that a person has posted a manual-reminder or TikTok-inbox post natively, which moves it from platform_action_required to published. Only for posts in platform_action_required that the user has already posted themselves. Nothing is sent to any platform.

tool_signatures.name: pause_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Pause a queue and unschedule any pending occurrence generated by it.

tool_signatures.name: preview_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Check whether a published post has mature measured performance and get a recommended Evergreen cadence. This does not create or schedule anything.

tool_signatures.name: publish_post
tool_signatures.description: Queue an immediate publish of a draft post. Returns a job run; poll get_job_run until status is succeeded or failed. For manual_reminder targets this queues a reminder for a person instead of calling the platform. The post goes public on the platform as soon as the run succeeds.

tool_signatures.name: refresh_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Refresh stored analytics only for the user

tool_signatures.name: resume_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Resume a paused queue and compute its next occurrence from the current time.

tool_signatures.name: suggest_post_times
tool_signatures.description: When this brand

tool_signatures.name: update_evergreen_queue
tool_signatures.description: Update a queue

tool_signatures.name: update_post
tool_signatures.description: Change a draft or scheduled post: its caption, its media, one channel

tool_signatures.name: upload_media
tool_signatures.description: upload_media
